test_requirement: Recruiters manage the job lifecycle: create drafts, edit, clone and soft delete jobs, and configure CV / Gate screening weights per job.

JOB-01-TC01.rule: Staff trong tenant mới được quản lý.
JOB-01-TC01.description: Verify only staff of the same tenant can manage a job.
JOB-01-TC01.procedure:
1. Log in as Recruiter of tenant A and open a job of tenant A, edit the title and save.
2. Log in as Candidate of tenant A and send PUT /api/v1/jobs/{id} for the same job.
3. Log in as Recruiter of tenant B and send PUT /api/v1/jobs/{id} with the tenant A job ID.
JOB-01-TC01.expected:
Step 1: the job is updated.
Step 2: HTTP 403, code FORBIDDEN.
Step 3: HTTP 404; the tenant A job is not changed.
JOB-01-TC01.precondition: Tenant A has a DRAFT job created by the Recruiter. Tenant B is ACTIVE.

JOB-01-TC02.rule: Không hard-delete khi đã có applicants.
JOB-01-TC02.description: Verify deleting a job with applicants is a soft delete.
JOB-01-TC02.procedure:
1. Log in as the job owner (Recruiter) of tenant A.
2. Delete a job that already has applications.
3. Check the job list, the job status and the applications of that job.
JOB-01-TC02.expected:
The job is not removed from the database: status becomes ARCHIVED and deleted_at is set.
The job disappears from the active job list.
Open applications of the job are closed as REJECTED; their history is kept.
JOB-01-TC02.precondition: The job has at least one application in NEW or IN_REVIEW.

JOB-01-TC03.rule: CV Screening Weights chỉ tính CV Score. Gate Screening Weights chỉ tổng hợp CV + AI Interview + Assessment.
JOB-01-TC03.description: Verify CV screening weights and gate screening weights are applied independently.
JOB-01-TC03.procedure:
1. Create a job with CV weights (skill 40, preferred 8, experience 12, education 0, jaccard 15, semantic 25) and gate weights (CV 40, AI Interview 35, Assessment 25).
2. Submit a CV and let the AI screen it.
3. Complete the AI interview and assessment for the candidate.
4. View the candidate scores on the job.
JOB-01-TC03.expected:
The CV score is calculated only from the CV weights.
The overall (gate) score combines only CV score, AI Interview score and Assessment score using the gate weights.
JOB-01-TC03.precondition: AI screening is enabled for the tenant; a candidate account exists.

JOB-01-TC04.rule: Backend từ chối weight âm, thiếu field, hoặc tổng ≠ 100%. Pass threshold 0–100.
JOB-01-TC04.description: Verify invalid screening weights and thresholds are rejected (boundary values).
JOB-01-TC04.procedure:
1. Log in as Recruiter of tenant A.
2. Save a job with one CV weight = -1.
3. Save with a missing weight field.
4. Save with weights totalling 99 and then 101.
5. Save with pass threshold = -1, 101, then 0 and 100.
JOB-01-TC04.expected:
Step 2: HTTP 400, code SCREENING_WEIGHT_NEGATIVE.
Step 3: HTTP 400, code SCREENING_WEIGHT_REQUIRED.
Step 4: HTTP 400, code SCREENING_WEIGHT_SUM.
Step 5: -1 and 101 return HTTP 400, code SCREENING_THRESHOLD_RANGE; 0 and 100 are saved.
JOB-01-TC04.precondition: Recruiter has permission to create jobs.

JOB-01-TC05.rule: Job cũ (trước V13) được snapshot công thức CV trước đây (40/8/12/0/15/25, ngưỡng 60) và gate 40/35/25 ngưỡng 70 để scoring không gãy. Recruiter đổi được sau.
JOB-01-TC05.description: Verify legacy jobs keep the default screening formula and can be changed later.
JOB-01-TC05.procedure:
1. Open a job created before migration V13.
2. View its screening configuration.
3. Change the CV weights and save.
JOB-01-TC05.expected:
Step 2: CV weights are 40/8/12/0/15/25 with pass threshold 60; gate weights are 40/35/25 with threshold 70.
Step 3: the new weights are saved and used for later scoring.
JOB-01-TC05.precondition: The tenant database contains a job created before migration V13.
